reviews.author: Gurpreet Singh
reviews.text: Ali bhai provides excellent tailoring services.The fitting was perfect, the stitching was neat, and the work was completed on time. The tailor was professional, friendly, and paid great attention to detail. Very happy with the final result and would definitely recommend their services.

reviews.author: Chiara Bursich
reviews.text:
I rarely leave reviews, but Ali Tailor truly impressed me.

They altered 6 dresses in just one hour, with incredible attention to detail and professionalism. What touched me even more was their kindness, they offered me food and fresh laban while I was waiting and made me feel genuinely welcome.

The team works incredibly hard, staying open until 11:30 PM, and one of their shops even operates 24/7. It’s rare to find this level of dedication, service, and hospitality nowadays.

If you’re looking for a reliable tailor who delivers quality work quickly, this is the place. I can honestly say I’ve finally found my go-to tailor for all my clothes.

Highly recommended!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 Service, professionalism, speed, and hospitality.

reviews.author: Eslamhassan H
reviews.text:
I had a truly wonderful experience at this shop. From the moment we arrived, everyone treated us with kindness, respect, and professionalism. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and very patient throughout the entire visit. They explained everything clearly and made sure we were completely satisfied.

A special thanks to Mr. Ali, who was exceptionally helpful, polite, and professional. He went above and beyond to make sure everything was taken care of, and his positive attitude made our experience even better.

The quality of the service was excellent, and you can really tell that customer satisfaction is their top priority. I am very happy with my experience, and I will definitely recommend this place to all of my friends and family. They truly deserve five stars for their outstanding customer service and professionalism. Thank you for making our visit such a pleasant one. I look forward to coming back again in the future!

reviews.author: Cecily Yim
reviews.text: I am deeply grateful for Ali Tailors for saving my favorite dress. Mr Ali's wife, Ms. Shuma is in charge of the women section and she skillfully, flawlessly altered my dress into perfection ! The dress was very tight on the chest area as it was a XS size (the only one left in the department store) and I badly needed to have it altered, giving more flexibility and room. MaashaAllah, like the other reviewers said,  Ali Tailors did not disappoint ! My dress feels much more comfortable now and you cannot find any trace of modification as if a magic ! Ms Shuma, friendly and cheerful, is such an excellent and seasoned tailor and I highly recommend them. I am so happy that I have found them in Dubai.
